description: Undoes the latest tendon_write (or the run named), newest first: removes the tendons, prestress, property, material, load case and load groups it created, puts back the model tendons it removed, and takes its load groups out of the construction stages. Every row is checked against the model first; if anything was changed since, nothing is touched. Refused in a different model. Previews unless apply: true.
name: tendon_write_undo
title: Undo a tendon write
